text: A song of ascents. Of David.How good and how pleasant it is,when brothers [1] dwell together as one!
Like fine oil on the head, [2] [AA]running down upon the beard,Upon the beard of Aaron,upon the collar of his robe.
Like dew [3] of Hermon [4] coming downupon the mountains of Zion. [AB]There the Lord has decreed a blessing,life for evermore! [AC]
